description: This Java file defines a PagerAdapter class for use with a ViewPager, managing a list of Fragment objects for a wearable Jumping Jack app.

classes.name: PagerAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that extends FragmentPagerAdapter to manage a list of Fragments for paging.

methods.name: PagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a FragmentManager and creates an empty list of fragments.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Retrieves the Fragment at the specified position.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of Fragments managed by the adapter.

methods.name: addFragment
methods.description: Adds a new Fragment to the list and notifies the adapter of data change.
